```{r fun}

generate_presentation_plot <- function(data, plot_type, mw_max = NULL) {
  data$subFleet <- factor(data$subFleet)
  data$area <- factor(data$area)
  
  if (plot_type == "landings") {
    lan_fleet_plot <- summarise(group_by(data, ctry, quarter, subFleet, area, year), catch_ton = sum(catch_t, na.rm = TRUE) / 9)
    
    p <- ggplot(lan_fleet_plot, aes(x = year, y = catch_ton, fill = ctry)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
      facet_grid(quarter ~ area + subFleet, drop = FALSE) + 
      scale_fill_manual(values = ddc.col, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(title = paste0("Landings, ", lan_fleet_plot$year), y = "tons") +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5))

    print(p)
    
  } else {

      if (plot_type == "relative age") {
        canum_sum <- summarise(group_by(data, year, quarter, area, subFleet, ctry), canum_total = sum(canum_1000))
        plot_dat <- mutate(left_join(data, canum_sum), canum_pct = canum_1000 / canum_total)
        y_var <- "canum_pct"
        y_label <- "relative number (%)"
        title_prefix <- "Relative number at age"
        
        p <- ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = wr, y = !!rlang::sym(y_var), group = ctry, col = ctry)) +
        geom_point() +
        geom_line() +
        facet_grid(quarter ~ area + subFleet, drop = F) + 
        scale_color_manual(values = ddc.col, drop=FALSE) +
        theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
        labs(title = paste0(title_prefix, ", ", unique(plot_dat$year)), y = y_label)
      
      print(p)
        
      } else if (plot_type == "mean_weight") {
        data$weca_g[data$weca_g == 0] <- NA
        plot_dat <- data
        y_var <- "weca_g"
        y_label <- "mean weight (g)"
        title_prefix <- "Mean weight at age"
        
        p <- ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = wr, y = !!rlang::sym(y_var), group = ctry, col = ctry)) +
        geom_point() +
        geom_line() +
        facet_grid(quarter ~ area + subFleet, drop = F) + 
        scale_color_manual(values = ddc.col, drop=FALSE) + 
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, mw_max)) +
        theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
        labs(title = paste0(title_prefix, ", ", unique(plot_dat$year)), y = y_label)
      
      print(p)
      }
      
      
    }
  }

```

```{r get_data, include = F}
# CANUM

canum <-
  readRDS(paste(
    "../data/",
    "C2_her2024_canum_without_imputations_2000_", year_0, ".rds",
    sep = ""
  ))

canum_0 <- subset(canum, year == year_0)

canum_a <- subset(canum, year == year_a)

canum_b <- subset(canum, year == year_b)

canum_c <- subset(canum, year == year_c)

canum_d <- subset(canum, year == year_d)

canum_3 <- bind_rows(canum_0, canum_a, canum_b, canum_c, canum_d)

canum_3$ctry <- as.factor(canum_3$ctry)
canum_3$area <- as.factor(canum_3$area)
canum_3$fleet <- as.factor(canum_3$fleet)
canum_3$quarter <- as.factor(canum_3$quarter)
canum_3$subFleet <- as.factor(canum_3$subFleet)
canum_3$year <- as.numeric(canum_3$year)

imp <-   read.csv(paste(
    "../data/",
    "11_her2024_canum_with_imputations_", year_0, ".csv",
    sep = ""
  ), sep = ";")

imp <- distinct(imp, ctry, year, area, fleet, subFleet, quarter, catch_t, 
                noSample, noLength, noAge, level, level_used)

year_imp <- min(as.numeric(substr(imp$level_used, 1, 4)), na.rm = T)

samples_available <- read.csv(paste(
    "../data/",
    "11_her2024_canum_with_samples_2000_", year_0, ".csv",
    sep = ""
  ), sep = ";")

samples_available <- distinct(samples_available, ctry, year, area, fleet, subFleet, quarter,
                noSample, noLength, noAge)

samples_available <- subset(samples_available, year >= year_imp)

samples_available_bio <- read.csv(paste(
    "../data/",
    "11_her2024_canum_with_samples_2000_", year_0, ".csv",
    sep = ""
  ), sep = ";")

samples_available_bio <- subset(samples_available_bio, year >= year_imp)
```

# Version `r paste0(lubridate::today(), "-v4")`

## Row

### Versions

2026-03-09-v1 - 1st version

2026-03-09-v2 - Updated with Norwegian purse seine biology from the transfer area. Updated plots

2026-03-10-v3 - Updated Danish input data. I had forgotten to delete numbers of sampled for 2 unsampled strata.

2026-03-10-v4 <- Removed 'Overall lan & samp'- and included SOP overview instead.

## Row

### Data & scripts
SC scripts can be found at https://github.com/KirstenBirchHaakansson/2026_her.27.20-24_RDBES_combined

Data in the boot folder at https://icesit.sharepoint.com/:f:/r/sites/ExpertGroup/HAWG/2026_Meeting_Documents/06.%20Data/WBSS/SC_data?csf=1&web=1&e=tXRkk3

## Row

### Notes
We need to see if we can improve national sampling, since a lot of the catches are unsampled.

Should we use the data call feedback to make countries aware of this problem?

# Overall lan, fig

## Row

### All the sub-fleets {.no-padding}

```{r, fig.width = 30}
lan_fleet_plot <- summarise(group_by(subset(canum_3, year == year_0), ctry, subFleet, area, year), catch_ton = sum(catch_t, na.rm = T)/9)


ggplot(lan_fleet_plot, aes(x = as.character(year), y = catch_ton, fill = ctry)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
    theme(legend.position="bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = ddc.col, drop=FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~paste(area, subFleet, sep = " - "), nrow = 1) +
  labs(title = paste0("Landings per subFleet and area, ", min(lan_fleet_plot$year), "-", max(lan_fleet_plot$year)),
       x = "year")
```

## Row {data-height="500"}

### Map sub-fleet to fleet {.no-padding}

***Mapping to fleet***

`canum$fleet[canum$area %in% c("27.3.a.20", "27.3.a.21") & canum$subFleet %in% c("passive", "purse seine", "trawl >= 32mm")] <- "C"`

`canum$fleet[canum$area %in% c("27.3.a.20", "27.3.a.21") & canum$subFleet %in% c("trawl < 32mm")] <- "D"`

`canum$fleet[canum$area %in% c("27.3.c.22", "27.3.b.23", "27.3.d.24")] <- "F"`

# Lan & samp, 27.3.a, ps


```{r, include = F}

canum_3a <- subset(canum_3, subFleet == "active >= 32mm" & area %in% c("27.3.b.23", "27.3.c.22", "27.3.d.24") & year == year_0)

imp_sub <- subset(imp, subFleet == "active >= 32mm" & area %in% c("27.3.b.23", "27.3.c.22", "27.3.d.24") & year == year_0 & level != 0)

samples_available_sub <- subset(samples_available, subFleet == "active >= 32mm" & area %in% c("27.3.b.23", "27.3.c.22", "27.3.d.24"))

samples_available_bio_sub <- subset(samples_available_bio, subFleet == "active >= 32mm" & area %in% c("27.3.b.23", "27.3.c.22", "27.3.d.24"))

mw_max <- max(samples_available_bio_sub$weca_g, na.rm = T)

```


## Row {data-height="500"}

### Landings, `r year_0`

```{r}
generate_presentation_plot(canum_3a, "landings")
```

### landings and samples `r year_0`

```{r, echo = F}
lan_samp <- distinct(
  subset(
    canum_3a, catch_t > 0
  ),
  year,
  catch_t,
  subFleet,
  area,
  ctry,
  quarter,
  noSample
)

ggplot(lan_samp, aes(x = noSample, y = catch_t, col = ctry)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3) +
  facet_grid(quarter ~ area) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ddc.col) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Landed tons per number of samples, ", year_0),
    x = "Number of sample",
    y = "Tons"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Row

### Landings and samples, `r year_0`
```{r}
canum_3a_1 <- distinct(subset(canum_3a, catch_t != 0),
                       ctry,
                       year,
                       quarter,
                       area,
                       subFleet,
                       noSample,
                       noLength,
                       noAge,
                       catch_t)

tab <- summarise(
  group_by(canum_3a_1, ctry, quarter, subFleet, area, year),
  catch_ton = sum(catch_t, na.rm = TRUE),
  noSample = sum(noSample),
  noLength = sum(noLength),
  noAge = sum(noAge)
)

datatable(
  tab,
  filter = 'top',
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    autoWidth = F,
    scrollY = F
    
  ),
  class = 'cell-border stripe'
) %>%
  formatRound(columns = c(6), digits = 3)
    
```

# Split

## Row

### WBSS (ton)

```{r, eval = F}
wbss_ton <- summarise(group_by(subset(splitted, stock == "WBSS"), year, fleet), caton = sum(caton, na.rm = T))

ggplot(wbss_ton, aes(
  x = year,
  y = caton,
  fill = fleet
)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = brewer.pal(5, "Dark2")[c(1:2, 4:5)], drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Landings of WBSS (tons) per year and fleet") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5))

```

### WBSS (number)

```{r, eval = F}
wbss_no <- summarise(group_by(subset(splitted, stock == "WBSS"), year, fleet), number = sum(canum_1000/1000, na.rm = T))

ggplot(wbss_no, aes(
  x = year,
  y = number,
  fill = fleet
)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = brewer.pal(4, "Dark2"), drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Landings of WBSS (number, mill.) per year and fleet") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5))
```

## Row

### Catch per fleet (ton)

```{r}
lan_sum <- summarise(group_by(canum_3, year, fleet), catch_ton = sum(catch_t, na.rm = T)/9)

lan_sum_t <- tidyr::spread(lan_sum, key = year, value = catch_ton, fill = 0)

knitr::kable(lan_sum_t)
```

## Row

### Catch per stock and fleet (ton)

```{r, eval = F}

lan_sum <- summarise(group_by(splitted, year, fleet, stock), caton = sum(caton, na.rm = T))

lan_sum_t <- tidyr::spread(lan_sum, key = year, value = caton, fill = 0)

knitr::kable(lan_sum_t)
```

<!-- ### Split proportions from Florian -->


```{r, eval = F}
split <-
  read.table(
    paste(
      "../boot/data/split_data/",
      "cmoe_split_",
      year_0,
      "_SD20SD21_v2.csv",
      sep = ""
    ),
    sep = ",",
    header = T
  )

split <- select(split, year, area, quarter, wr, nsas, wbss, n)
split$area <- ifelse(split$area == "20", "27.3.a.20", "27.3.a.21")

knitr::kable(split)
```
